name: shinchantw_cbt_d0_d1_feature_comparison_retention_split_20260730_193457_684860
sql:
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
D0Users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND e."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
DailyPay AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        e."$part_date" AS pay_date,
        COUNT(*) AS pay_orders,
        SUM(CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(x.exchange, 1)) AS pay_amount_usd
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x
      ON e."$part_date" = x.ex_date
     AND e.pay_currency = x.currency
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-30'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
D1ActiveUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN D0Users u ON e."#account_id" = u.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-30'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'login'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
UserSegment AS (
    SELECT
        u.account_id,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p29.pay_orders, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(p30.pay_orders, 0) > 0 THEN 'A.D0未付、D1付费'
            WHEN COALESCE(p29.pay_orders, 0) = 0 AND d1a.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'B.D0未付、D1活跃未付（对照）'
            WHEN COALESCE(p29.pay_orders, 0) = 0 THEN 'C.D0未付、D1已流失'
            WHEN COALESCE(p29.pay_orders, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(p30.pay_orders, 0) > 0 THEN 'D.D0付费、D1继续付费'
            ELSE 'E.其他D0新增'
        END AS user_segment,
        COALESCE(p29.pay_orders, 0) AS d0_pay_orders,
        COALESCE(p29.pay_amount_usd, 0.0) AS d0_pay_amount_usd,
        COALESCE(p30.pay_orders, 0) AS d1_pay_orders,
        COALESCE(p30.pay_amount_usd, 0.0) AS d1_pay_amount_usd
    FROM D0Users u
    LEFT JOIN DailyPay p29 ON u.account_id = p29.account_id AND p29.pay_date = '2026-07-29'
    LEFT JOIN DailyPay p30 ON u.account_id = p30.account_id AND p30.pay_date = '2026-07-30'
    LEFT JOIN D1ActiveUsers d1a ON u.account_id = d1a.account_id
),
D0Events AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        e."#event_time" AS event_time,
        e."#event_name" AS event_name
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN D0Users u ON e."#account_id" = u.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
EventGaps AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        event_name,
        DATE_DIFF('second', CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP), LEAD(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time)) AS next_gap_seconds
    FROM D0Events
),
D0Engagement AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS d0_event_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT event_name) AS d0_distinct_event_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN next_gap_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 119 THEN next_gap_seconds ELSE 0 END) / 60.0 AS d0_active_minutes
    FROM EventGaps
    GROUP BY 1
),
D0Stage AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        MAX(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT), TRY_CAST(e.stage_id AS BIGINT))) AS max_stage_id,
        COUNT(*) AS stage_attempts,
        COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT), TRY_CAST(e.stage_id AS BIGINT))) AS distinct_stages
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN D0Users u ON e."#account_id" = u.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
D0Guide AS (
    SELECT e."#account_id" AS account_id, COUNT(*) AS guide_event_count
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN D0Users u ON e."#account_id" = u.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."#event_name" = 'gamer_guide'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
D0Role AS (
    SELECT e."#account_id" AS account_id, MAX(TRY_CAST(e.role_lev AS BIGINT)) AS d0_max_role_level
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN D0Users u ON e."#account_id" = u.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
D0ToyUpgrade AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS toy_upgrade_times,
        MAX(TRY_CAST(e.level_after AS BIGINT)) AS max_toy_level
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN D0Users u ON e."#account_id" = u.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'toy_up'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
D0ActivityConsume AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        SUM(REDUCE(e.a_rst, CAST(0 AS BIGINT), (s, x) -> s + CASE WHEN CAST(x.id AS BIGINT) = 430001 AND CAST(x.before AS BIGINT) > CAST(x.after AS BIGINT) THEN ABS(CAST(x.diff AS BIGINT)) ELSE 0 END, s -> s)) AS amusement_park_consume,
        SUM(REDUCE(e.a_rst, CAST(0 AS BIGINT), (s, x) -> s + CASE WHEN CAST(x.id AS BIGINT) = 430006 AND CAST(x.before AS BIGINT) > CAST(x.after AS BIGINT) THEN ABS(CAST(x.diff AS BIGINT)) ELSE 0 END, s -> s)) AS limited_event_consume
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN D0Users u ON e."#account_id" = u.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'item_change'
      AND ANY_MATCH(e.a_rst, x -> CAST(x.id AS BIGINT) IN (430001, 430006))
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
D0ActivityGift AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) IN (119201, 119202, 119203, 119204, 119205, 119206) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amusement_park_gift_orders,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(e.product_id AS BIGINT) IN (119701, 119702, 119703, 119704, 119705, 119706) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS limited_event_gift_orders
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN D0Users u ON e."#account_id" = u.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
D0Gacha AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e."$part_event" = 'skill_get' THEN e.len ELSE 0 END) AS skill_gacha_times,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e."$part_event" = 'Companion_get' THEN e.len ELSE 0 END) AS companion_gacha_times
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN D0Users u ON e."#account_id" = u.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."$part_event" IN ('skill_get', 'Companion_get')
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
UserFeature AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(g.d0_active_minutes, 0.0) AS d0_active_minutes,
        COALESCE(g.d0_event_count, 0) AS d0_event_count,
        COALESCE(g.d0_distinct_event_count, 0) AS d0_distinct_event_count,
        st.max_stage_id,
        COALESCE(st.stage_attempts, 0) AS stage_attempts,
        COALESCE(st.distinct_stages, 0) AS distinct_stages,
        COALESCE(gu.guide_event_count, 0) AS guide_event_count,
        COALESCE(r.d0_max_role_level, 0) AS d0_max_role_level,
        COALESCE(t.toy_upgrade_times, 0) AS toy_upgrade_times,
        COALESCE(t.max_toy_level, 0) AS max_toy_level,
        COALESCE(a.amusement_park_consume, 0) AS amusement_park_consume,
        COALESCE(a.limited_event_consume, 0) AS limited_event_consume,
        COALESCE(ag.amusement_park_gift_orders, 0) AS amusement_park_gift_orders,
        COALESCE(ag.limited_event_gift_orders, 0) AS limited_event_gift_orders,
        COALESCE(ga.skill_gacha_times, 0) AS skill_gacha_times,
        COALESCE(ga.companion_gacha_times, 0) AS companion_gacha_times
    FROM UserSegment s
    LEFT JOIN D0Engagement g ON s.account_id = g.account_id
    LEFT JOIN D0Stage st ON s.account_id = st.account_id
    LEFT JOIN D0Guide gu ON s.account_id = gu.account_id
    LEFT JOIN D0Role r ON s.account_id = r.account_id
    LEFT JOIN D0ToyUpgrade t ON s.account_id = t.account_id
    LEFT JOIN D0ActivityConsume a ON s.account_id = a.account_id
    LEFT JOIN D0ActivityGift ag ON s.account_id = ag.account_id
    LEFT JOIN D0Gacha ga ON s.account_id = ga.account_id
)
SELECT
    user_segment AS "用户分群",
    COUNT(*) AS "用户数",
    ROUND(AVG(d0_active_minutes), 1) AS "D0平均活跃分钟",
    ROUND(AVG(d0_event_count), 1) AS "D0平均事件数",
    ROUND(AVG(d0_distinct_event_count), 1) AS "D0平均事件类型数",
    ROUND(AVG(max_stage_id), 1) AS "D0平均最高主线关卡ID",
    ROUND(AVG(stage_attempts), 1) AS "D0平均主线挑战次数",
    ROUND(AVG(distinct_stages), 1) AS "D0平均经过主线关卡数",
    ROUND(AVG(guide_event_count), 1) AS "D0平均引导事件数",
    ROUND(AVG(d0_max_role_level), 1) AS "D0平均最高用户等级",
    ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN toy_upgrade_times > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "D0玩具升级参与率(%)",
    ROUND(AVG(max_toy_level), 1) AS "D0玩具升级最高等级(含未升级用户为0)",
    ROUND(AVG(toy_upgrade_times), 1) AS "D0人均玩具升级次数",
    ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN amusement_park_consume > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "D0游乐园活动参与率(%)",
    ROUND(AVG(amusement_park_consume), 1) AS "D0人均游乐园道具消耗",
    ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN limited_event_consume > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "D0限时专属活动参与率(%)",
    ROUND(AVG(limited_event_consume), 1) AS "D0人均限时专属道具消耗",
    ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN amusement_park_gift_orders > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "D0游乐园礼包购买率(%)",
    ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN limited_event_gift_orders > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "D0限时专属礼包购买率(%)",
    ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN skill_gacha_times + companion_gacha_times > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "D0抽卡参与率(%)",
    ROUND(AVG(skill_gacha_times), 1) AS "D0人均技能抽卡次数",
    ROUND(AVG(companion_gacha_times), 1) AS "D0人均伙伴抽卡次数",
    ROUND(AVG(d0_pay_amount_usd), 2) AS "人均D0充值USD",
    ROUND(AVG(d1_pay_amount_usd), 2) AS "人均D1充值USD"
FROM UserFeature
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
